species.name: Tyranitar Redux
species.dexText: A Tyranitar is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. It roams in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.

species.name: Tyranitar Mega Redux
species.dexText: A Tyranitar is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. It roams in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.

species.name: Lugia
species.dexText: Lugia is so powerful even a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart houses. As a result, it chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

species.name: Ho-Oh
species.dexText: Its feathers--which glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light--are thought to bring joy. It is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

species.name: Celebi
species.dexText: This Pokémon came from the future by crossing over time. It is thought that so long as Celebi appears, a bright and shining future awaits us.

species.name: Treecko
species.dexText: It makes its nest in a giant tree in the forest. It ferociously guards against anything nearing its territory. It is said to be the protector of the forest's trees.

species.name: Grovyle
species.dexText: Leaves grow out of this Pokémon's body. They help obscure a Grovyle from the eyes of its enemies while it is in a thickly overgrown forest.

species.name: Sceptile
species.dexText: In the jungle, its power is without equal. This Pokémon carefully grows trees and plants. It regulates its body temperature by basking in sunlight.

species.name: Sceptile Mega
species.dexText: In the jungle, its power is without equal. This Pokémon carefully grows trees and plants. It regulates its body temperature by basking in sunlight.

species.name: Torchic
species.dexText: If attacked, it strikes back by spitting balls of fire it forms in its stomach. A Torchic dislikes darkness because it can't see its surroundings.

species.name: Combusken
species.dexText: It lashes out with 10 kicks per second. Its strong fighting instinct compels it to keep up its offensive until the opponent gives up.

species.name: Blaziken
species.dexText: It learns martial arts that use punches and kicks. Every several years, its old feathers burn off, and new, supple feathers grow back in their place.

species.name: Blaziken Mega
species.dexText: It learns martial arts that use punches and kicks. Every several years, its old feathers burn off, and new, supple feathers grow back in their place.

species.name: Mudkip
species.dexText: On land, it can powerfully lift large boulders by planting its four feet and heaving. It sleeps by burying itself in soil at the water's edge.

species.name: Marshtomp
species.dexText: Its toughened hind legs enable it to stand upright. Because it weakens if its skin dries out, it replenishes fluids by playing in mud.

species.name: Swampert
species.dexText: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.

species.name: Swampert Mega
species.dexText: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.

species.name: Poochyena
species.dexText: It savagely threatens foes with bared fangs. It chases after fleeing targets tenaciously. It turns tail and runs, however, if the foe strikes back.

species.name: Mightyena
species.dexText: In the wild, Mightyena live in a pack. They never defy their leader's orders. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

species.name: Zigzagoon
species.dexText: Rubbing its nose against the ground, it always wanders about back and forth in search of something. It is distinguished by the zigzag footprints it leaves.

species.name: Linoone
species.dexText: It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run in a straight line. When it spots pond- dwelling prey underwater, it quickly leaps in and catches it with its sharp claws.

species.name: Zigzagoon Galarian
species.dexText: Rubbing its nose against the ground, it always wanders about back and forth in search of something. It is distinguished by the zigzag footprints it leaves.

species.name: Linoone Galarian
species.dexText: It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run in a straight line. When it spots pond- dwelling prey underwater, it quickly leaps in and catches it with its sharp claws.

species.name: Wurmple
species.dexText: It sticks to tree branches and eats leaves. The thread it spits from its mouth, which becomes gooey when it touches air, slows the movement of its foes.

species.name: Cascoon
species.dexText: To avoid detection by its enemies, it hides motionlessly beneath large leaves and in the gaps of branches. It also attaches dead leaves to its body for camouflage.

species.name: Cascoon Primal
species.dexText: To avoid detection by its enemies, it hides motionlessly beneath large leaves and in the gaps of branches. It also attaches dead leaves to its body for camouflage.

species.name: Silcoon
species.dexText: It prepares for evolution using the energy it stored while it was a Wurmple. It keeps watch over the surroundings with its two eyes.

species.name: Beautifly
species.dexText: Its colorfully patterned wings are its most prominent feature. It flies through flower-covered fields collecting pollen. It attacks ferociously when angered.

species.name: Dustox
species.dexText: It is a nocturnal Pokémon that flies from fields and mountains to the attraction of streetlights at night. It looses highly toxic powder from its wings.

species.name: Lotad
species.dexText: This Pokémon lives in ponds with clean water. It is known to ferry small Pokémon across ponds by carrying them on the broad leaf on its head.

species.name: Lombre
species.dexText: In the evening, it takes great delight in popping out of rivers and startling people. It feeds on aquatic moss that grows on rocks in the riverbed.

species.name: Ludicolo
species.dexText: When it hears festive music, all the cells in its body become stimulated, and it begins moving in rhythm. It does not quail even when it faces a tough opponent.

species.name: Seedot
species.dexText: It hangs off branches and absorbs nutrients. When it finishes eating, its body becomes so heavy that it drops to the ground with a thump.

species.name: Nuzleaf
species.dexText: A forest-dwelling Pokémon that is skilled at climbing trees. Its long and pointed nose is its weak point. It loses power if the nose is gripped.

species.name: Shiftry
species.dexText: It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds. Feared from long ago as the guardian of forests, this Pokémon lives in a deep forest where people do not venture.

species.name: Taillow
species.dexText: Although it is small, it is very courageous. It will take on a larger Skarmory on an equal footing. However, its will weakens if it becomes hungry.

species.name: Swellow
species.dexText: A Swellow dives upon prey from far above. It never misses its targets. It takes to the skies in search of lands with a warm climate.

species.name: Wingull
species.dexText: It makes its nest on a sheer cliff at the edge of the sea. It has trouble keeping its wings flapping in flight. Instead, it soars on updrafts.

species.name: Pelipper
species.dexText: It skims the tops of waves as it flies. When it spots prey, it uses its large beak to scoop up the victim with water. It protects its eggs in its beak.

species.name: Ralts
species.dexText: A Ralts has the power to sense the emotions of people and Pokémon with the horns on its head. It takes cover if it senses any hostility.

species.name: Kirlia
species.dexText: A Kirlia has the psychic power to create a rip in the dimensions and see into the future. It is said to dance with pleasure on sunny mornings.

species.name: Gardevoir
species.dexText: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its Trainer.

species.name: Gallade
species.dexText: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows when trying to protect someone. It can sense what its foe is thinking.

species.name: Gardevoir Mega
species.dexText: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its Trainer.

species.name: Gallade Mega
species.dexText: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows when trying to protect someone. It can sense what its foe is thinking.

species.name: Surskit
species.dexText: They gather on puddles after evening downpours, gliding across the surface of water as if sliding. It secretes honey with a sweet aroma from its head.

species.name: Masquerain
species.dexText: It intimidates foes with the large eyelike patterns on its antennae. Because it can't fly if its wings get wet, it shelters itself from rain under large trees and eaves.

species.name: Shroomish
species.dexText: It loves to eat damp, composted soil in forests. If you enter a forest after a long rain, you can see many Shroomish feasting on composted soil.

species.name: Breloom
species.dexText: It scatters spores from holes in the cap on its head. It loves warm and humid climates. It feeds on trees and plants in fields and forests.

species.name: Breloom Mega
species.dexText: It scatters spores from holes in the cap on its head. It loves warm and humid climates. It feeds on trees and plants in fields and forests.

species.name: Slakoth
species.dexText: It sleeps virtually all day and night long. It doesn't change its nest its entire life, but it sometimes travels great distances by swimming in rivers.

species.name: Vigoroth
species.dexText: It can't keep still because its blood boils with energy. It runs through the fields and mountains all day to calm itself. If it doesn't, it can't sleep at night.

species.name: Slaking
species.dexText: Hordes of Slaking gather around trees when fruits come into season. They wait around patiently for ripened fruits to fall out of the trees.

species.name: Slaking Mega
species.dexText: Hordes of Slaking gather around trees when fruits come into season. They wait around patiently for ripened fruits to fall out of the trees.

species.name: Slaking Mega Ape Shift
species.dexText: Hordes of Slaking gather around trees when fruits come into season. They wait around patiently for ripened fruits to fall out of the trees.

species.name: Nincada
species.dexText: It makes its nest at the roots of a mighty tree. Using its whiskerlike antennae, it probes its surroundings in the pitch-black darkness of soil.

species.name: Shedinja
species.dexText: A peculiar Pokémon that floats in air even though its wings remain completely still. The inside of its body is hollow and utterly dark.

species.name: Shedinja Mega
species.dexText: A peculiar Pokémon that floats in air even though its wings remain completely still. The inside of its body is hollow and utterly dark.

species.name: Ninjask
species.dexText: Because it darts about vigorously at high speed, it is very difficult to see. Hearing its distinctive cries for too long induces a headache.

species.name: Whismur
species.dexText: Its cries equal a jet plane in volume. It inhales through its ear canals. Because of this system, it can cry continually without having to catch its breath.

species.name: Loudred
species.dexText: It positions the round speakers on its head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves at massive volume. It builds power by stomping the ground.

species.name: Exploud
species.dexText: It has sound-generating organs all over its body. It communicates with others by adjusting the tone and volume of the cries it emits.

species.name: Whismur Redux
species.dexText: Its cries equal a jet plane in volume. It inhales through its ear canals. Because of this system, it can cry continually without having to catch its breath.

species.name: Loudred Redux
species.dexText: It positions the round speakers on its head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves at massive volume. It builds power by stomping the ground.

species.name: Exploud Redux
species.dexText: It has sound-generating organs all over its body. It communicates with others by adjusting the tone and volume of the cries it emits.

species.name: Makuhita
species.dexText: It loves to toughen up its body above all else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave, it is the sound of Makuhita undertaking strenuous training.

species.name: Hariyama
species.dexText: It has the habit of challenging others without hesitation to tests of strength. It's been known to stand on train tracks and stop trains using forearm thrusts.

species.name: Azurill
species.dexText: Its tail, which is packed with nutrition, is very bouncy like a rubber ball. On sunny days they gather at the edge of water and splash about for fun.

species.name: Nosepass
species.dexText: Its body emits a powerful magnetism. It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold seasons.

species.name: Skitty
species.dexText: A Skitty's adorably cute behavior makes it highly popular. In battle, it makes its tail puff out. It threatens foes with a sharp growl.

species.name: Delcatty
species.dexText: Rather than keeping a permanent lair, it habitually seeks comfortable spots and sleeps there. It is nocturnal and becomes active at dusk.

species.name: Sableye
species.dexText: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A Sableye lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.

species.name: Sableye Mega
species.dexText: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A Sableye lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.

species.name: Sableye Redux
species.dexText: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A Sableye lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.

species.name: Sableye Mega Redux
species.dexText: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A Sableye lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.

species.name: Mawile
species.dexText: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.

species.name: Mawile Mega
species.dexText: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.

species.name: Mawile Redux
species.dexText: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.

species.name: Mawile Mega Redux
species.dexText: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.

species.name: Mawile Redux B
species.dexText: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.

species.name: Mawile Redux B Mega
species.dexText: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.

species.name: Aron
species.dexText: A Pokémon that is clad in steel armor. A new suit of armor is made when it evolves. The old, discarded armor is salvaged as metal for making iron products.

species.name: Lairon
species.dexText: When two Lairon meet in the wild, they fight for territory by bashing into each other with their steel bodies. The sound of their collision carries for miles.

species.name: Aggron
species.dexText: Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They are used to determine the Aggron's age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.

species.name: Aggron Mega
species.dexText: Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They are used to determine the Aggron's age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.

species.name: Meditite
species.dexText: It continually meditates for hours every day. As a result of rigorous and dedicated yoga training, it has tempered its spiritual power so much it can fly.

species.name: Medicham
species.dexText: Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it gained the power to foretell its foe's actions. It battles with elegant, dance- like movement.

species.name: Medicham Mega
species.dexText: Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it gained the power to foretell its foe's actions. It battles with elegant, dance- like movement.

species.name: Electrike
species.dexText: It generates electricity using friction from the atmosphere. In seasons with especially arid air, its entire body blazes with violent showers of sparks.

species.name: Manectric
species.dexText: Because lightning falls in their vicinities, Manectric were thought to have been born from lightning. In battle, they create thunderclouds.

species.name: Manectric Mega
species.dexText: Because lightning falls in their vicinities, Manectric were thought to have been born from lightning. In battle, they create thunderclouds.

species.name: Plusle
species.dexText: It has the trait of cheering on its fellow Pokémon. By shorting out the electricity it releases from its paws, it creates pom-poms for cheering.

species.name: Minun
species.dexText: At a meeting of Pokémon academics, it was announced that simultaneous exposure to electricity from a Plusle and Minun will promote circulation and boost vitality.

species.name: Volbeat
species.dexText: With their taillights lit, Volbeat fly in a swarm, drawing geometric designs in the night sky. They move their nests if their pond water becomes dirty.

species.name: Illumise
species.dexText: A nocturnal Pokémon that becomes active upon nightfall. It leads a Volbeat swarm to draw patterns in the night sky. Over 200 different patterns have been confirmed.

species.name: Roselia
species.dexText: A Roselia that drinks nutritionally rich springwater blooms with lovely flowers. The fragrance of its flowers has the effect of making its foes careless.

species.name: Roserade
species.dexText: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. With the movements of a dancer, it strikes with whips that are densely lined with poison thorns.

species.name: Roserade Mega
species.dexText: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. With the movements of a dancer, it strikes with whips that are densely lined with poison thorns.

species.name: Gulpin
species.dexText: This Pokémon's stomach fluid can even digest scrap iron. In one gulp, it can swallow something that is as large as itself.

species.name: Swalot
species.dexText: Its powerful stomach acid is capable of digesting almost anything. The one thing in the whole world a Swalot can't digest is its own stomach.

species.name: Swalot Mega
species.dexText: Its powerful stomach acid is capable of digesting almost anything. The one thing in the whole world a Swalot can't digest is its own stomach.

species.name: Carvanha
species.dexText: Carvanha attack ships in swarms, making them sink. Although it is said to be a very vicious Pokémon, it timidly flees as soon as it finds itself alone.

species.name: Sharpedo
species.dexText: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.

species.name: Sharpedo Mega
species.dexText: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.

species.name: Wailmer
species.dexText: While this Pokémon usually lives in the sea, it can survive on land, although not too long. It loses vitality if its body becomes dried out.

species.name: Wailord
species.dexText: It breathes through nostrils that it raises above the sea. By inhaling to its maximum capacity, a Wailord can dive close to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.

species.name: Numel
species.dexText: A Numel stores boiling magma in the hump on its back. It is a hardy Pokémon that can transport a 220-pound load. It has served humans at work since long ago.

species.name: Camerupt
species.dexText: A Pokémon that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.

species.name: Camerupt Mega
species.dexText: A Pokémon that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.

species.name: Torkoal
species.dexText: It battles using energy it gets from burning coal. When loosing smoke from its nostrils, it lets off a sound that is similar to a locomotive's horn.

species.name: Spoink
species.dexText: A Pokémon that manipulates psychic power at will. It doesn't stop bouncing even when it is asleep. It loves eating mushrooms that grow underground.

species.name: Grumpig
species.dexText: It stores power in the black pearls on its forehead. When it uses psychic power, it performs an odd dance step. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

species.name: Spinda
species.dexText: It is distinguished by a pattern of spots that is always different. Its unsteady, tottering walk has the effect of fouling its foe's aim.

species.name: Trapinch
species.dexText: Its big jaws crunch through boulders. Because its head is so big, it has a hard time getting back upright if it tips over onto its back.

species.name: Vibrava
species.dexText: It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its wings together. Since a Vibrava's wings are still in the process of growing, it can only fly short distances.

species.name: Flygon
species.dexText: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.

species.name: Flygon Redux B
species.dexText: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.

species.name: Flygon Mega
species.dexText: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.

species.name: Flygon Mega
species.dexText: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.

species.name: Trapinch Redux
species.dexText: Its big jaws crunch through boulders. Because its head is so big, it has a hard time getting back upright if it tips over onto its back.

species.name: Vibrava Redux
species.dexText: It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its wings together. Since a Vibrava's wings are still in the process of growing, it can only fly short distances.

species.name: Flygon Redux
species.dexText: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.

species.name: Flygon Redux Mega
species.dexText: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.

species.name: Cacnea
species.dexText: Cacnea live in deserts with virtually no rainfall. It battles by swinging its thick, spiked arms. Once a year, a yellow flower blooms.

species.name: Cacturne
species.dexText: After spending thousands of years in harsh deserts, its blood transformed into the same substances as sand. It is nocturnal, so it hunts at night.

species.name: Swablu
species.dexText: A Pokémon that has wings like cottony clouds. After enduring winter, in which little food is available, Swablu flocks move closer to towns in the spring.

species.name: Altaria
species.dexText: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.

species.name: Altaria Mega
species.dexText: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.

species.name: Zangoose
species.dexText: When it battles, it stands on its hind legs and attacks with its sharply clawed forelegs. Its fur bristles if it encounters any Seviper.

species.name: Seviper
species.dexText: Seviper and Zangoose are eternal rivals. It counters a Zangoose's dazzling agility with its swordlike tail, which also oozes a horrible poison.

species.name: Lunatone
species.dexText: It becomes very active on the night of a full moon. This Pokémon was first discovered 40 years ago at the site of a meteor strike.

species.name: Solrock
species.dexText: Solar energy is the source of this Pokémon's power. On sunny days, groups of Solrock line up facing the sun and absorb its light.

species.name: Solrock System
species.dexText: Solar energy is the source of this Pokémon's power. On sunny days, groups of Solrock line up facing the sun and absorb its light.

species.name: Barboach
species.dexText: Its body is covered with a slimy film. The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs in muddy water from entering the Barboach's body.

species.name: Whiscash
species.dexText: Mysteriously, it can foretell earthquakes. In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it continually feeds throughout the night.

species.name: Corphish
species.dexText: Once it grips prey with its large pincers, it will never let go, no matter what. It is a hardy Pokémon that can thrive in any environment.

species.name: Crawdaunt
species.dexText: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. A veteran Crawdaunt that has prevailed in hundreds of battles has giant pincers marked with countless scars.

species.name: Baltoy
species.dexText: A Baltoy moves by spinning on its single foot. It has been depicted in murals adorning the walls of a once-bustling city in an ancient age.

species.name: Claydol
species.dexText: A Claydol sleeps while hovering in midair. Its arms are separate from its body. They are kept floating by the Pokémon's manipulation of psychic power.

species.name: Lileep
species.dexText: It disguises itself as seaweed by making its tentacles sway. Unsuspecting prey that come too close are swallowed whole. It became extinct 100 million years ago.

species.name: Cradily
species.dexText: It drags its heavy body along the seafloor. It makes its nest in the shallows of warm seas. Cradily can be seen on beaches when the tide goes out.

species.name: Anorith
species.dexText: It was resurrected from a fossil using the power of science. It swims by undulating the eight wings at its sides. They were feet that adapted to life in the sea.

species.name: Armaldo
species.dexText: Armaldo usually lives on land. However, when it hunts for prey, it dives beneath the ocean. It swims around using its two large wings.

species.name: Feebas
species.dexText: Feebas live in ponds that are heavily infested with weeds. Because of its hopelessly shabby appearance, it seems as if few Trainers raise it.

species.name: Milotic
species.dexText: It is said to live at the bottom of large lakes. Considered to be the most beautiful of all Pokémon, it has been depicted in paintings and statues.

species.name: Milotic Mega
species.dexText: It is said to live at the bottom of large lakes. Considered to be the most beautiful of all Pokémon, it has been depicted in paintings and statues.

species.name: Castform
species.dexText: It alters its form depending on the weather. Changes in the climate such as the temperature and humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

species.name: Castform Sandy
species.dexText: It alters its form depending on the weather. Changes in the climate such as the temperature and humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

species.name: Castform Sunny
species.dexText: It alters its form depending on the weather. Changes in the climate such as the temperature and humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

species.name: Castform Rainy
species.dexText: It alters its form depending on the weather. Changes in the climate such as the temperature and humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

species.name: Castform Snowy
species.dexText: It alters its form depending on the weather. Changes in the climate such as the temperature and humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

species.name: Castform Foggy
species.dexText: It alters its form depending on the weather. Changes in the climate such as the temperature and humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

species.name: Kecleon
species.dexText: A Pokémon that has the ability to alter its body colors to match its surroundings. A Kecleon reverts to its original colors if it is startled.

species.name: Shuppet
species.dexText: This Pokémon roams about deep in the night seeking such negative emotions as grudges and envy. It retreats to its nest when the sun begins to rise.

species.name: Banette
species.dexText: An abandoned plush doll became this Pokémon. They are said to live in garbage dumps and wander about in search of the children that threw them away.

species.name: Banette Mega
species.dexText: An abandoned plush doll became this Pokémon. They are said to live in garbage dumps and wander about in search of the children that threw them away.

species.name: Duskull
species.dexText: A glare from its single scarlet eye makes even burly grown-ups freeze in utter fear. It is a nocturnal Pokémon that roams about under the cloak of darkness.

species.name: Dusclops
species.dexText: It is thought that its body is hollow with only a spectral ball of fire burning inside. However, no one has been able to confirm this theory as fact.

species.name: Tropius
species.dexText: It flies by flapping its broad leaves. The bunch of fruit that grows around its neck is deliciously sweet. In the spring, it scatters pollen from its neck.

species.name: Chimecho
species.dexText: They fly about very actively when the hot season arrives. They communicate among themselves using seven different and distinguishing cries.

species.name: Absol
species.dexText: It sharply senses even subtle changes in the sky and the land to predict natural disasters. It is a long-lived Pokémon that has a life-span of 100 years.

species.name: Absol Mega
species.dexText: It sharply senses even subtle changes in the sky and the land to predict natural disasters. It is a long-lived Pokémon that has a life-span of 100 years.

species.name: Wynaut
species.dexText: A Wynaut loves to eat sweet fruits. It cleverly picks fruits using its earlike arms. They gather in fruit gardens, drawn by the fragrance.

species.name: Snorunt
species.dexText: They tend to move about in groups of around five Snorunt. In snowy regions, it is said that when they are seen late at night, snowfall will arrive by morning.

species.name: Glalie
species.dexText: A Glalie has the power to instantaneously freeze moisture in the atmosphere. A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice crystals forms around its body.

species.name: Froslass
species.dexText: When it finds people or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become its decorations.

species.name: Glalie Mega
species.dexText: A Glalie has the power to instantaneously freeze moisture in the atmosphere. A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice crystals forms around its body.

species.name: Froslass Mega
species.dexText: When it finds people or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become its decorations.

species.name: Snorunt Redux
species.dexText: They tend to move about in groups of around five Snorunt. In snowy regions, it is said that when they are seen late at night, snowfall will arrive by morning.

species.name: Glalie Redux
species.dexText: A Glalie has the power to instantaneously freeze moisture in the atmosphere. A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice crystals forms around its body.

species.name: Froslass Redux
species.dexText: When it finds people or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become its decorations.

species.name: Glalie Redux Mega
species.dexText: A Glalie has the power to instantaneously freeze moisture in the atmosphere. A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice crystals forms around its body.

species.name: Froslass Redux Mega
species.dexText: When it finds people or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become its decorations.

species.name: Spheal
species.dexText: It is completely covered with plushy fur. As a result, it never feels the cold even when it is rolling about on ice floes or diving in the sea.

species.name: Sealeo
species.dexText: Sealeo live in herds on ice floes. Using its powerful flippers, it shatters ice. It dives into the sea to hunt prey five times a day.

species.name: Walrein
species.dexText: To protect its herd, the leader battles anything that invades its territory, even at the cost of its life. Its tusks may snap off in battle.

species.name: Clamperl
species.dexText: A Clamperl slams its shell closed on prey to prevent escape. The pearl it creates upon evolution is said to be infused with a mysterious energy.

species.name: Huntail
species.dexText: To withstand the crushing pressure of water deep under the sea, its spine is very thick and sturdy. Its tail, which is shaped like a small fish, has eyes that light up.

species.name: Gorebyss
species.dexText: A Gorebyss siphons the body fluids of prey through its thin, tubular mouth. Its light pink body color turns vivid when it finishes feeding.

species.name: Relicanth
species.dexText: A Pokémon that was once believed to have been extinct. The species has not changed its form for 100 million years. It walks on the seafloor using its pectoral fins.

species.name: Relicanth Mega
species.dexText: A Pokémon that was once believed to have been extinct. The species has not changed its form for 100 million years. It walks on the seafloor using its pectoral fins.

species.name: Luvdisc
species.dexText: Luvdisc make the branches of Corsola their nests. There is a custom from long ago of giving a Luvdisc as a gift to express one's feelings of love.

species.name: Bagon
species.dexText: Although it is small, this Pokémon is very powerful because its body is a bundle of muscles. It launches head-butts with its ironlike skull.

species.name: Shelgon
species.dexText: It hardly eats while it awaits evolution. It becomes hardier by enduring hunger. Its shell peels off the instant it begins to evolve.

species.name: Salamence
species.dexText: After many long years, its cellular structure underwent a sudden mutation to grow wings. When angered, it loses all thought and rampages out of control.

species.name: Salamence Mega
species.dexText: After many long years, its cellular structure underwent a sudden mutation to grow wings. When angered, it loses all thought and rampages out of control.

species.name: Beldum
species.dexText: When Beldum gather in a swarm, they move in perfect unison as if they were but one Pokémon. They communicate with each other using brain waves.

species.name: Metang
species.dexText: The claws tipping its arms pack the destructive power to tear through thick iron sheets as if they were silk. It flies at over 60 miles per hour.

species.name: Metagross
species.dexText: Metagross has four brains that are joined by a complex neural network. As a result of integration, this Pokémon is smarter than a supercomputer.

species.name: Metagross Mega
species.dexText: Metagross has four brains that are joined by a complex neural network. As a result of integration, this Pokémon is smarter than a supercomputer.

species.name: Regirock
species.dexText: A Pokémon that is made entirely of rocks and boulders. If parts of its body chip off in battle, Regirock repairs itself by adding new rocks.

species.name: Regice
species.dexText: Its entire body is made of Antarctic ice. After extensive studies, researchers believe the ice was formed during an ice age.

species.name: Registeel
species.dexText: Its body is harder than any other kind of metal. The body metal is composed of a mysterious substance. Not only is it hard, it shrinks and stretches flexibly.

species.name: Latias
species.dexText: They make a small herd of only several members. They rarely make contact with people or other Pokémon. They disappear if they sense enemies.

species.name: Latias Mega
species.dexText: They make a small herd of only several members. They rarely make contact with people or other Pokémon. They disappear if they sense enemies.

species.name: Latios
species.dexText: Even in hiding, it can detect the locations of others and sense their emotions since it has telepathy. Its intelligence allows it to understand human languages.

species.name: Latios Mega
species.dexText: Even in hiding, it can detect the locations of others and sense their emotions since it has telepathy. Its intelligence allows it to understand human languages.

species.name: Kyogre
species.dexText: Kyogre has appeared in mythology as the creator of the sea. After long years of feuding with Groudon, it took to sleep at the bottom of the sea.

species.name: Kyogre Primal
species.dexText: Kyogre has appeared in mythology as the creator of the sea. After long years of feuding with Groudon, it took to sleep at the bottom of the sea.

species.name: Groudon
species.dexText: Groudon has appeared in mythology as the creator of the land. It sleeps in magma underground and is said to make volcanoes erupt on awakening.

species.name: Groudon Primal
species.dexText: Groudon has appeared in mythology as the creator of the land. It sleeps in magma underground and is said to make volcanoes erupt on awakening.

species.name: Rayquaza
species.dexText: A Pokémon that flies endlessly in the ozone layer. It is said it would descend to the ground if Kyogre and Groudon were to fight.

species.name: Rayquaza Mega
species.dexText: A Pokémon that flies endlessly in the ozone layer. It is said it would descend to the ground if Kyogre and Groudon were to fight.

species.name: Jirachi
species.dexText: Jirachi is said to make wishes come true. While it sleeps, a tough crystalline shell envelops the body to protect it from enemies.

species.name: Deoxys
species.dexText: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and can shoot lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

species.name: Deoxys Attack
species.dexText: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and can shoot lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

species.name: Deoxys Defense
species.dexText: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and can shoot lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

species.name: Deoxys Speed
species.dexText: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and can shoot lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

species.name: Turtwig
species.dexText: The shell on its back is made of soil.  On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell should feel moist. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

species.name: Grotle
species.dexText: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater well.  It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

species.name: Torterra
species.dexText: Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra's back and spend their entire life there. Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

species.name: Torterra Mega

species.name: Turtwig Redux
species.dexText: The shell on its back is made of soil.  On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell should feel moist. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

species.name: Grotle Redux
species.dexText: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater well.  It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

species.name: Chimchar
species.dexText: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Before going to sleep, Chimchar extinguish the flame on their tails to prevent fires.

species.name: Monferno
species.dexText: It carefully controls the intensity of the flame on its tail, so as to keep its foes at an adequate distance. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

species.name: Infernape
species.dexText: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all of its limbs to take on any opponent.

species.name: Piplup
species.dexText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.

species.name: Prinplup
species.dexText: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group. It searches for prey in icy seas.

species.name: Empoleon
species.dexText: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.

species.name: Empoleon Mega
species.dexText: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.

species.name: Starly
species.dexText: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. However, they bicker if the group grows too big. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

species.name: Staravia
species.dexText: Recognizing their own weakness, they maintain huge flocks. Fierce scuffles break out between various flocks. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

species.name: Staraptor
species.dexText: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

species.name: Bidoof
species.dexText: A comparison revealed that Bidoof's front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata's. It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth.

species.name: Bibarel
species.dexText: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.

species.name: Kricketot
species.dexText: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone. These sounds are fall hallmarks.

species.name: Kricketune
species.dexText: It signals its emotions with its melodies. There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

species.name: Shinx
species.dexText: It rapidly contracts and relaxes its muscles to generate electricity. Its body shines if endangered. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

species.name: Luxio
species.dexText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch has enough amperage to cause fainting in foes.

species.name: Luxray
species.dexText: It has eyes which can see through anything. Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

species.name: Luxray Mega
species.dexText: It has eyes which can see through anything. Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

species.name: Luxray Redux
species.dexText: It has eyes which can see through anything. Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

species.name: Budew
species.dexText: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. Sensitive to changing temperature, the bud is said to bloom when it feels the sun's warm touch.

species.name: Cranidos
species.dexText: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, its skull is as hard as iron.  It would snap obstructing trees with headbutts.

species.name: Rampardos
species.dexText: The result of repeated headbutts is a skull grown thick and hard. However, its brain has shrunk in size compared with Cranidos's.

species.name: Shieldon
species.dexText: This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles. Few enemies would have been willing to square off against its heavily armored face, so it's thought.

species.name: Bastiodon
species.dexText: Their rock-hard faces serve to protect them from any frontral attacks. When attacked, they form a wall. They shielded their young in that way.

species.name: Burmy
species.dexText: It is covered with a cloak that shelters it from the cold. If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.

species.name: Wormadam
species.dexText: Its appearance changes depending on where Burmy evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body. The cloak is never shed.

species.dexText: It is covered with a cloak that shelters it from the cold. If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.

species.name: Mothim
species.dexText: It does not keep a nest. While it loves floral honey, it won't gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal honey collected by Combee.

species.name: Combee
species.dexText: A Pokémon formed by three others. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

species.name: Vespiquen
species.dexText: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding. There is only one in a colony.

species.name: Pachirisu
species.dexText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

species.name: Buizel
species.dexText: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement. It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw.

species.name: Floatzel
species.dexText: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

species.name: Buizel Redux
species.dexText: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement. It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw.

species.name: Floatzel Redux
species.dexText: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

species.name: Cherubi
species.dexText: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is also very sweet and tasty. Pokémon like Starly and Taillow try to peck it off.

species.name: Cherrim
species.dexText: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active. It folds back into a bud if sunlight wanes.

species.name: Cherrim Sunshine
species.dexText: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active. It folds back into a bud if sunlight wanes.

species.name: Shellos
species.dexText: Its shape and coloration vary, depending on its habitat. Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.

species.name: Gastrodon
species.dexText: It lives in shallow tidal pools. Gastrodon once had a huge shell for protection in ancient times. There are traces of it left in its cells.

species.name: Shellos East
species.dexText: Its shape and coloration vary, depending on its habitat. Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.

species.name: Gastrodon East
species.dexText: It lives in shallow tidal pools. Gastrodon once had a huge shell for protection in ancient times. There are traces of it left in its cells.

species.name: Ambipom
species.dexText: They live on large trees. Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, Ambipom rarely uses its hands now.

species.name: Drifloon
species.dexText: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.” Children holding them sometimes vanish.

species.name: Drifblim
species.dexText: Even while under careful observation, large flocks of Drifblim flying at dusk will inexplicably disappear from view. No one knows where they go.

species.name: Buneary
species.dexText: You can tell how it feels by the way it rolls its ears. When it's scared, both ears are rolled up. When it senses danger, it perks them up.

species.name: Lopunny
species.dexText: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It is very conscious of its looks and never fails to groom its ears. It runs with sprightly jumps.

species.name: Lopunny Mega
species.dexText: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It is very conscious of its looks and never fails to groom its ears. It runs with sprightly jumps.

species.name: Mismagius
species.dexText: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations. It appears where you least expect it.

species.name: Honchkrow
species.dexText: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous Murkrow in tow. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its cronies.

species.name: Glameow
species.dexText: It is a very fickle Pokémon, which is very popular among some. It claws its Trainer's nose if it isn't fed and purrs when affectionate.

species.name: Purugly
species.dexText: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own. It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger.

species.name: Chingling
species.dexText: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound. It can cry for an awfully long time.

species.name: Stunky
species.dexText: It protects itself by spraying a nose-curling, stinky fluid from its rear to repel attackers. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

species.name: Skuntank
species.dexText: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.

species.name: Bronzor
species.dexText: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

species.name: Bronzong
species.dexText: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. One caused a news stir when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2000-year sleep.

species.name: Bonsly
species.dexText: Bonsly prefers an arid atmosphere. In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it exudes water from its eyes. This makes it appear to be crying.

species.name: Mime Jr.
species.dexText: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

species.name: Mr. Mime
species.dexText: A Mr. Mime is a master of pantomime. It can convince others that something unseeable actually exists. Once believed, the imaginary object does become real.

species.name: Mr Mime Galarian
species.dexText: A Mr. Mime is a master of pantomime. It can convince others that something unseeable actually exists. Once believed, the imaginary object does become real.

species.name: Happiny
species.dexText: It carries a round white rock in its belly pouch. If it gets along well with someone, it will sometimes give that person the rock.

species.name: Chansey
species.dexText: Chansey lay nutritionally excellent eggs every day. The eggs are so delicious, they are eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.

species.name: Blissey
species.dexText: If it senses sadness with its fluffy fur, a Blissey will rush over to the sad person, however far away, to share an egg of happiness that brings a smile to any face.

species.name: Happiny Redux
species.dexText: It carries a round white rock in its belly pouch. If it gets along well with someone, it will sometimes give that person the rock.

species.name: Chansey Redux

species.name: Blissey Redux

species.name: Chatot
species.dexText: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it. It can also learn and speak human words.

species.name: Spiritomb
species.dexText: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

species.name: Spiritomb Redux
species.dexText: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

species.name: Gible
species.dexText: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who stray too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.

species.name: Gabite
species.dexText: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

species.name: Garchomp
species.dexText: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It is covered in fine scales that reduce drag, enabling it to fly at high speeds.

species.name: Garchomp Mega
species.dexText: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It is covered in fine scales that reduce drag, enabling it to fly at high speeds.

species.name: Garchomp Redux

species.name: Garchomp Mega Redux
species.dexText: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It is covered in fine scales that reduce drag, enabling it to fly at high speeds.

species.name: Munchlax
species.dexText: When it finds something that looks like it might be edible, it goes right ahead and swallows it whole. That's why it gets fatter day by day.

species.name: Snorlax
species.dexText: Snorlax's typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile Pokémon that there are children who use its big belly as a place to play.

species.name: Snorlax Mega
species.dexText: Snorlax's typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile Pokémon that there are children who use its big belly as a place to play.

species.name: Riolu
species.dexText: It can discern the physical and emotional states of people, Pokémon, and other natural things from the shape of their aura waves.

species.name: Lucario
species.dexText: It understands human speech. It is said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect Auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.

species.name: Lucario Mega X
species.dexText: It understands human speech. It is said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect Auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.

species.name: Lucario Mega Y
species.dexText: It understands human speech. It is said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect Auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.

species.name: Hippopotas
species.dexText: Hippopotas shuts its nostrils tight when travelling through sand. Instead of perspiration, it expels grains of sand from its body.

species.name: Hippowdon
species.dexText: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength and raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.

species.name: Skorupi
species.dexText: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes. It can survive a year without food.

species.name: Drapion
species.dexText: Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength. It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap out of a car.

species.name: Croagunk
species.dexText: Croagunk rarely fights fairly. Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

species.name: Toxicroak
species.dexText: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

species.name: Carnivine
species.dexText: Hanging from branches using its tentacles, it looks like a plant. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down.

species.name: Finneon
species.dexText: Its double tail fins propel its energetic jumps. When it breaks the surface of the sea, Wingull swoop down to grab it on the fly.

species.name: Lumineon
species.dexText: Lumineon swimming in the darkness of the deep sea look like stars shining in the night sky. It competes for food with Lanturn.

species.name: Mantyke
species.dexText: When it swims close to the surface of the ocean, people aboard ships are able to observe the pattern on its back. It often swims in a school of Remoraid.

species.name: Snover
species.dexText: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.

species.name: Abomasnow
species.dexText: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”

species.name: Abomasnow Mega
species.dexText: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”

species.name: Abomasnow Mega
species.dexText: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”

species.name: Lickilicky
species.dexText: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

species.name: Rhyperior
species.dexText: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening and then expanding its muscles instantaneously. Geodude are shot at rare times.

species.name: Tangrowth
species.dexText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Even if one of its arms is eaten, it's fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly and will go right back to normal.

species.name: Electivire
species.dexText: When it gets excited, it thumps its chest. With every thud, thunder roars, electric sparks shower all around and blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

species.name: Magmortar
species.dexText: According to what is known, a single pair of male and female Magmortar lives in one volcano. From its arm, it launches fireballs hotter than 3,600ºF.

species.name: Togekiss
species.dexText: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings. It will never appear where there is strife.

species.name: Yanmega
species.dexText: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.

species.name: Leafeon
species.dexText: Its cellular composition is closer to that of a plant than an animal. It uses photosynthesis to produce its energy supply without eating food.

species.name: Glaceon
species.dexText: It can control its body temperature at will. This enables it to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.

species.name: Mamoswine
species.dexText: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement. This Pokémon has been around for a long, long, long time.

species.name: Porygon-Z
species.dexText: In order to create a more advanced Pokémon, an additional program was installed, but apparently it contained a defect that made it move oddly.

species.name: Probopass
species.dexText: It freely controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force. With them, it can attack its foes from three directions.

species.name: Dusknoir
species.dexText: This feared Pokémon is said to travel to worlds unknown. Some even believe that it takes lost spirits into its pliant body and guides them home.

species.name: Rotom
species.dexText: Research continues on this Pokémon. Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control, in order to make mischief.

species.name: Rotom Heat
species.dexText: Research continues on this Pokémon. Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control, in order to make mischief.

species.name: Rotom Fan

species.name: Rotom Mow
species.dexText: Research continues on this Pokémon. Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control, in order to make mischief.

species.name: Uxie
species.dexText: Known as ”The Being of Knowledge,” according to some sources, this Pokémon provided people with the intelligence necessary to solve various problems.

species.name: Uxie Redux
species.dexText: Known as ”The Being of Knowledge,” according to some sources, this Pokémon provided people with the intelligence necessary to solve various problems.

species.name: Mesprit
species.dexText: Although it slumbers at the bottom of a lake, its spirit is said to leave its body and flitter on the water surface. It taught humans of sorrow, pain, and joy.

species.name: Mesprit Redux
species.dexText: Although it slumbers at the bottom of a lake, its spirit is said to leave its body and flitter on the water surface. It taught humans of sorrow, pain, and joy.

species.name: Azelf
species.dexText: This Pokémon is said to have endowed humans with the determination needed to do things. It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf all came from the same egg.

species.name: Azelf Redux
species.dexText: This Pokémon is said to have endowed humans with the determination needed to do things. It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf all came from the same egg.

species.name: Dialga
species.dexText: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.

species.name: Dialga Origin
species.dexText: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.

species.name: Palkia
species.dexText: Palkia has the ability to distort space. Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places and other dimensions.

species.name: Palkia Origin
species.dexText: Palkia has the ability to distort space. Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places and other dimensions.

species.name: Heatran
species.dexText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It dwells in volcanic caves, using its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

species.name: Regigigas
species.dexText: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon shaped Regirock, Regice, and Registeel out of clay, ice, and magma.

species.name: Giratina
species.dexText: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange. It was banished for its violence.

species.name: Giratina Origin
species.dexText: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange. It was banished for its violence.

species.name: Cresselia
species.dexText: Those who sleep holding one of Cresselia's feathers are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

species.name: Phione
species.dexText: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs. It always returns to where it was born.

species.name: Manaphy
species.dexText: Water makes up 80% of its body. It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

species.name: Darkrai
species.dexText: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers. However, it means no harm.

species.name: Darkrai Nightmare
species.dexText: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers. However, it means no harm.

species.name: Shaymin
species.dexText: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude. The blooming of Gracideas confers the power of flight upon it.

species.name: Shaymin Sky
species.dexText: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude. The blooming of Gracideas confers the power of flight upon it.

species.name: Arceus
species.dexText: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world, before the universe even existed.

species.name: Victini
species.dexText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

species.name: Victini Primal
species.dexText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

species.name: Snivy
species.dexText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

species.name: Servine
species.dexText: When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps clean. They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage.

species.name: Serperior
species.dexText: They raise their heads to intimidate foes, but only give it their all when fighting powerful opponents who are not fazed by the glare from its noble eyes.

species.name: Serperior Mega
species.dexText: They raise their heads to intimidate foes, but only give it their all when fighting powerful opponents who are not fazed by the glare from its noble eyes.

species.name: Tepig
species.dexText: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp. It blows fire through its nose.

species.name: Pignite
species.dexText: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

species.name: Emboar
species.dexText: It is adept at using many different moves. It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

species.name: Emboar Mega
species.dexText: It is adept at using many different moves. It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

species.name: Oshawott
species.dexText: The scalchop on its stomach isn't just used for battle, it can be used to break open hard berries as well. It is made from the same element as its claws.

species.name: Dewott
species.dexText: Strict training and disclipine leads it to master its flowing double-scalchop technique. Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another.

species.name: Samurott
species.dexText: One swing of the seamitars attached to its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them is enough to intimidate most enemies.

species.name: Samurott Hisuian
species.dexText: One swing of the seamitars attached to its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them is enough to intimidate most enemies.

species.name: Samurott Mega
species.dexText: One swing of the seamitars attached to its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them is enough to intimidate most enemies.

species.name: Patrat
species.dexText: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days.

species.name: Watchog
species.dexText: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.

species.name: Lillipup
species.dexText: It faces strong opponents with great courage. Because it doesn't yelp, it's extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.

species.name: Herdier
species.dexText: Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed makes this a troublesome Pokémon to train.

species.name: Stoutland
species.dexText: Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, there could be no concern that it would ever attack people. Some parents even trust it to babysit.

species.name: Purrloin
species.dexText: Their deceptively cute act is the perfect ruse. They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them.

species.name: Liepard
species.dexText: Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur. These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. They run silently in the night.

species.name: Pansage
species.dexText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

species.name: Simisage
species.dexText: Ill tempered, it attacks enemies by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

species.name: Pansage Redux
species.dexText: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

species.name: Simisage Redux
species.dexText: Ill tempered, it attacks enemies by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

species.name: Pansear
species.dexText: The fire within the tuft on its head can reach up to 600ºF. Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

species.name: Simisear
species.dexText: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

species.name: Pansear Redux
species.dexText: The fire within the tuft on its head can reach up to 600ºF. Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

species.name: Simisear Redux
species.dexText: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

species.name: Panpour
species.dexText: The water stored inside the tuft of its head is rich in nutrients. It waters plants using its tail, plants that receive its water grow large.

species.name: Simipour
species.dexText: It can shoot highly-pressurised water from its tail with enough power to break through a solid concrete wall. It prefers places with clean water.

species.name: Panpour Redux
species.dexText: The water stored inside the tuft of its head is rich in nutrients. It waters plants using its tail, plants that receive its water grow large.

species.name: Simipour Redux
species.dexText: It can shoot highly-pressurised water from its tail with enough power to break through a solid concrete wall. It prefers places with clean water.

species.name: Munna
species.dexText: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams. Munna always float in the air.

species.name: Musharna
species.dexText: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon. It changes into different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

species.name: Pidove
species.dexText: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

species.name: Tranquill
species.dexText: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it can always return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance.

species.name: Unfezant
species.dexText: Males have plumage on their heads. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males. They will only let themselves feel close to their Trainers.

species.name: Blitzle
species.dexText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate with one another.

species.name: Zebstrika
species.dexText: When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates. It is dangerous when it's angry as it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

species.name: Roggenrola
species.dexText: The hexagonal cavity is its ear. It walks in the direction of sounds it hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics and topples over.

species.name: Boldore
species.dexText: Its orange crystal is a mass of energy. Just one crystal fragment would provide enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks. When it is healthy, its core sticks out.

species.name: Gigalith
species.dexText: The blasts of energy it makes from sunbeams have terrifying power. However, it's not able to fire its blasts at night or on rainy days.

species.name: Woobat
species.dexText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.

species.name: Swoobat
species.dexText: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

species.name: Drilbur
species.dexText: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph by spinning its body. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

species.name: Excadrill
species.dexText: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels, but it can also help with construction.

species.name: Audino
species.dexText: Its auditory sense is astounding. Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

species.name: Audino Mega
species.dexText: Its auditory sense is astounding. Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

species.name: Timburr
species.dexText: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.

species.name: Gurdurr
species.dexText: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

species.name: Conkeldurr
species.dexText: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. Rather than rely solely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.

species.name: Tympole
species.dexText: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk and warns others of danger.

species.name: Palpitoad
species.dexText: It lives in the water and on land. When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

species.name: Seismitoad
species.dexText: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. They can also shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps.

species.name: Throh
species.dexText: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts. It changes belts as it gets more powerful.

species.name: Sawk
species.dexText: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train. Disturbing their training angers them.

species.name: Sewaddle
species.dexText: It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth. Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes, it is a mascot for fashion designers.

species.name: Swadloon
species.dexText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

species.name: Leavanny
species.dexText: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to weave warm wrappings for Sewaddle by using the silk secreted from its mouth.

species.name: Venipede
species.dexText: Using the feelers on its head and tail, it picks up vibrations in the air to determine its prey's location and state. It is brutally aggressive.

species.name: Whirlipede
species.dexText: Storing energy for evolution, it sits. But when attacked, it spins its body at high speed like a wheel and then crashes furiously into its opponent.

species.name: Scolipede
species.dexText: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails. Then it finishes them off with deadly poison.

species.name: Cottonee
species.dexText: When it finds others of its kind, they all stick together. When enough of them have collected, the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.

species.name: Whimsicott
species.dexText: It rides on the wind and slips into people's homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton-filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.

species.name: Petilil
species.dexText: By pruning the leaves on its head with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

species.name: Lilligant
species.dexText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. It withers away if a trainer does not take good care of it.

species.name: Lilligant Hisuian
species.dexText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. It withers away if a trainer does not take good care of it.

species.name: Basculin
species.dexText: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school. These Pokémon are very hostile.

species.name: Basculegion
species.dexText: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream.

species.name: Basculegion F
species.dexText: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream.

species.name: Basculin White
species.dexText: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school. These Pokémon are very hostile.

species.name: Basculin Blue
species.dexText: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school. These Pokémon are very hostile.

species.name: Sandile
species.dexText: It conceals itself in the sand and chomps down on the legs of any prey that unwarily walk over it. Its favorite food is Trapinch.

species.name: Krokorok
species.dexText: They move in groups of a few individuals. Thanks to the special membrane covering its eyes, it can see its surroundings clearly, even in the dead of night.

species.name: Krookodile
species.dexText: Very violent Pokémon, they never allow their prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

species.name: Krookodile Mega
species.dexText: Very violent Pokémon, they never allow their prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

species.name: Darumaka
species.dexText: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it pulls its limbs into its body and falls asleep.

species.name: Darmanitan
species.dexText: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

species.name: Darmanitan Zen
