species.name: Maractus
species.dexText: Arid regions are their habitat. When it moves rhythmically, it makes a sound similar to maracas, making the surprised Pokémon flee.

species.name: Dwebble
species.dexText: It makes a hole in a stone of a suitable size. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

species.name: Crustle
species.dexText: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle and begins to weaken.

species.name: Scraggy
species.dexText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck. Its skull is massively thick.

species.name: Scrafty
species.dexText: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader, and is the most respected.

species.name: Scrafster
species.dexText: They keep their shed skin even after it has fully dried up to make them look more imposing. They use their tails as a bat to engage in combat.

species.name: Sigilyph
species.dexText: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders. They use their psychic power to attack enemies.

species.name: Yamask
species.dexText: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human.

species.name: Yamask Galarian
species.dexText: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human.

species.name: Cofagrigus
species.dexText: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

species.name: Tirtouga
species.dexText: Reputed to be the ancestor of most turtle Pokémon, it lived in warm seas about a hundred million years ago. It was restored from a fossil.

species.name: Carracosta
species.dexText: They can live both in the ocean and on land. Incredible jaw strength enables them to chew up steel beams and rocks along with their prey.

species.name: Archen
species.dexText: Said to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, Archen itself could not actually fly but moved by hopping from treetop to treetop.

species.name: Archeops
species.dexText: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. When one Archeops had the prey cornered, another would swoop on it.

species.name: Trubbish
species.dexText: It gorges on trash until its stomach is full. Then it belches toxic gas. An unlucky whiff of this gas will put a person in the hospital.

species.name: Garbodor
species.dexText: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you'll experience the full effects of this unidentified toxin.

species.name: Garbodor Mega
species.dexText: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you'll experience the full effects of this unidentified toxin.

species.name: Zorua
species.dexText: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

species.name: Zoroark
species.dexText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents. They defend their lair with illusory scenery.

species.name: Zorua Hisuian
species.dexText: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

species.name: Zoroark Hisuian
species.dexText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents. They defend their lair with illusory scenery.

species.name: Minccino
species.dexText: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

species.name: Cinccino
species.dexText: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Cinccino's body is coated in a special oil that repels dust and helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.

species.name: Gothita
species.dexText: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, Gothita are looking at something that only they can see. Their ribbonlike feelers increase their power.

species.name: Gothorita
species.dexText: Starlight is the source of their power. They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading them astray are told in every corner.

species.name: Gothitelle
species.dexText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power. When it learns its Trainer's life span, it cries in sadness.

species.name: Solosis
species.dexText: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

species.name: Duosion
species.dexText: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these Pokémon exhibit their maximized psychic power.

species.name: Reuniclus
species.dexText: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains.

species.name: Reuniclus Partner
species.dexText: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains.

species.name: Reuniclus Partner B
species.dexText: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains.

species.name: Reuniclus Partner C
species.dexText: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains.

species.name: Solosis Redux
species.dexText: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

species.name: Duosion Redux
species.dexText: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these Pokémon exhibit their maximized psychic power.

species.name: Reuniclus Redux
species.dexText: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains.

species.name: Reuniclus Mega
species.dexText: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains.

species.name: Ducklett
species.dexText: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

species.name: Swanna
species.dexText: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles. The one in the middle is the leader of the flock.

species.name: Vanillite
species.dexText: The temperature of their breath is -58ºF. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them. Vanillite is treasured by households in warm regions.

species.name: Vanillish
species.dexText: Vanillish has existed since the Ice Age. It controls particles of ice, freezes its opponents, and then shatters them with a headbutt.

species.name: Vanilluxe
species.dexText: Each of its two heads has a brain, and when they are in agreement, it attacks its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard. It makes snow clouds inside its body.

species.name: Deerling
species.dexText: Their coloring changes according to the seasons and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well. People use it to mark the seasons.

species.name: Sawsbuck
species.dexText: Some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring because the plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leader possesses magnificent horns.

species.dexText: Some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring because the plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leader possesses magnificent horns.

species.name: Emolga
species.dexText: It glides using its cape-like membrane. It grills berries and bug Pokémon with electric shocks from the pouches on its cheeks and makes a meal of them.

species.name: Karrablast
species.dexText: When they feel threatened, they spit an acidic liquid to drive attackers away. For some reason they evolve while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

species.name: Escavalier
species.dexText: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances. The steel armor protects their whole body.

species.name: Foongus
species.dexText: It lures Pokémon in with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball, then releases its poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

species.name: Amoonguss
species.dexText: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

species.name: Frillish
species.dexText: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap an opponent, that foe will be dragged five miles below the surface to its lair, never to return.

species.name: Jellicent
species.dexText: They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their bodies. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

species.name: Jellicent Mega
species.dexText: They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their bodies. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

species.name: Alomomola
species.dexText: When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore. The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

species.name: Joltik
species.dexText: Since they can't generate their own electricity, they attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in a pouch.

species.name: Galvantula
species.dexText: It creates barriers from electrified silk that stun foes. This works as a weapon as well as a defense. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

species.name: Ferroseed
species.dexText: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling of caves. When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes.

species.name: Ferrothorn
species.dexText: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers and shooting spikes. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

species.name: Klink
species.dexText: Two bodies comprise a fixed pair. The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

species.name: Klang
species.dexText: A minigear and big gear comprise its body. Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

species.name: Klinklang
species.dexText: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

species.name: Tynamo
species.dexText: These Pokémon move in schools. One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

species.name: Eelektrik
species.dexText: These Pokémon have a big appetite. It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

species.name: Eelektross
species.dexText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean, with their sucker mouths.

species.name: Elgyem
species.dexText: It psychically squeezes the brain of its foe, causing unendurable headaches. Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

species.name: Beheeyem
species.dexText: It can manipulate an opponent's memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three fingers, but those patterns haven't been decoded.

species.name: Litwick
species.dexText: While Litwick shines a light and pretends to be a guide, it absorbs the life force of any who follow it, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

species.name: Lampent
species.dexText: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen. The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire.

species.name: Chandelure
species.dexText: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

species.name: Axew
species.dexText: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly, harder and sturdier than the last.

species.name: Fraxure
species.dexText: Their tusks can shatter rocks. A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

species.name: Haxorus
species.dexText: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams.

species.name: Haxorus Mega
species.dexText: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams.

species.name: Cubchoo
species.dexText: Its nose is always running. Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.

species.name: Beartic
species.dexText: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

species.name: Cryogonal
species.dexText: They are born in snow clouds. When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

species.name: Shelmet
species.dexText: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast.

species.name: Accelgor
species.dexText: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in layers of thin membrane. It is very light and fights with ninja-like movements.

species.name: Stunfisk
species.dexText: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

species.name: Stunfisk Galarian
species.dexText: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

species.name: Mienfoo
species.dexText: They have mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise. What it lacks in power, it makes up for in quantity.

species.name: Mienshao
species.dexText: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

species.name: Mienshao Mega
species.dexText: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

species.name: Druddigon
species.dexText: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

species.name: Golett
species.dexText: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization. It's been active for thousands of years.

species.name: Golurk
species.dexText: Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon by an ancient civilisation. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

species.name: Pawniard
species.dexText: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey. If battling dulls them, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

species.name: Bisharp
species.dexText: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

species.name: Kingambit
species.dexText: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it's not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

species.name: Bouffalant
species.dexText: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

species.name: Rufflet
species.dexText: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it's a carnivore at heart.

species.name: Braviary
species.dexText: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if it is injured. One can carry a car while flying.

species.name: Braviary Hisuian
species.dexText: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if it is injured. One can carry a car while flying.

species.name: Vullaby
species.dexText: It can't fly yet and must wait until its wings have developed more. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.

species.name: Mandibuzz
species.dexText: They adorn themselves beautifully with bones. This is supposedly an effort to attract males, but no male Mandibuzz have ever been found.

species.name: Heatmor
species.dexText: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. They burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

species.name: Durant
species.dexText: Durant dig nests in mountains. Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.

species.name: Deino
species.dexText: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

species.name: Zweilous
species.dexText: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves on to another area. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

species.name: Hydreigon
species.dexText: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

species.dexText: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. It spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

species.name: Volcarona
species.dexText: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it appeared and saved Pokémon from freezing, Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

species.name: Cobalion
species.dexText: It has a body and heart of steel. This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

species.name: Terrakion
species.dexText: Spoken of in legend, this Pokémon used its phenomenal power to destroy a castle in its effort to protect Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

species.name: Virizion
species.dexText: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Legends say this Pokémon used whirlwind-like movements to confound and swiftly cut its opponents.

species.name: Tornadus
species.dexText: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power can blow entire houses away. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

species.name: Tornadus Therian

species.name: Thundurus
species.dexText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.

species.name: Thundurus Therian
species.dexText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.

species.name: Reshiram
species.dexText: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

species.name: Zekrom
species.dexText: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It has a generator that creates electricity in its tail. It assists those with strong ideals.

species.name: Landorus
species.dexText: Hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields”, the energy that pours from its tail increases the nutrition in the soil, making crops grow to great size.

species.name: Landorus Therian
species.dexText: Hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields”, the energy that pours from its tail increases the nutrition in the soil, making crops grow to great size.

species.name: Kyurem
species.dexText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals. Its body became frozen when its energy leaked out.

species.name: Keldeo Resolute
species.dexText: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers.

species.name: Quilladin
species.dexText: They strengthen the sturdy shell covering their bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights, but will counterattack with sharp quills.

species.name: Chesnaught
species.dexText: It shields its allies from danger with its own body. When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it can withstand a bomb blast.

species.name: Fennekin

species.name: Braixen
species.dexText: Braixen has a twig stuck in its tail. When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

species.name: Delphox
species.dexText: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future. It uses psychic power to incinerate its foes.

species.name: Frogadier
species.dexText: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away. Frogadier's swiftness is unparalleled.

species.name: Greninja
species.dexText: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars made of compressed water.

species.name: Bunnelby
species.dexText: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly. Bunnelby dig the whole night through.

species.name: Diggersby
species.dexText: With its powerful ears it reduces dense bedrock to rubble. It can be a big help at construction sites. When it's finished digging, it lounges about lazily.

species.name: Fletchling
species.dexText: This amiable Pokémon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side. It's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

species.name: Fletchinder
species.dexText: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on any bewildered Pokémon that pop out of the grass.

species.name: Talonflame
species.dexText: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.

species.name: Scatterbug
species.dexText: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact. Scatterbug can live in any region or climate.

species.name: Spewpa
species.dexText: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

species.name: Pyroar
species.dexText: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride. The females protect the pride's cubs. They viciously threaten any challenger.

species.dexText: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats on the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

species.name: Floette
species.dexText: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance. It draws out the power of flowers to battle.

species.name: Florges
species.dexText: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory. In times long past, governors of castles would invite Florges to create gardens to embellish the castle domains.

species.name: Gogoat
species.dexText: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being. They inhabit mountainous regions.

species.name: Pancham
species.dexText: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

species.name: Pangoro
species.dexText: It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro's Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.

species.dexText: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself. The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears.

species.name: Meowstic
species.dexText: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.

species.dexText: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

species.name: Doublade
species.dexText: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords. The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even against those skilled at swordplay.

species.name: Aegislash
species.dexText: Generations of kings were attended to by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

species.name: Spritzee
species.dexText: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked. Its fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

species.name: Aromatisse
species.dexText: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

species.name: Swirlix
species.dexText: Because it eats nothing but sweets, its fur is as sticky sweet as cotton candy. To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes sticky white threads.

species.name: Slurpuff
species.dexText: Slurpuff can distinguish even the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

species.name: Inkay
species.dexText: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

species.name: Malamar
species.dexText: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids. It forces others to do whatever it wants.

species.name: Binacle
species.dexText: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.

species.name: Barbaracle
species.dexText: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

species.name: Skrelp
species.dexText: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, it hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution. They spray liquid poison on prey that approach unawares.

species.name: Dragalge
species.dexText: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker. Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

species.name: Clauncher
species.dexText: Through controlled expulsions of internal gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot. At close distances, it can even shatter large rocks.

species.name: Clawitzer
species.dexText: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its enormous claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots. They launch cannonballs made of water.

species.name: Helioptile
species.dexText: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their own energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

species.name: Heliolisk
species.dexText: A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper. It can stimulate its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs.

species.name: Tyrunt
species.dexText: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up a car. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

species.name: Tyrantrum
species.dexText: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

species.name: Amaura
species.dexText: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years. It lived in a cold land where there were no predators.

species.name: Aurorus
species.dexText: Using the diamond-shaped crystals on its body it can instantly create a wall of ice to block an opponent's attack, or encase them in ice.

species.name: Sylveon
species.dexText: Its ribbonlike feelers give off an aura that weakens hostility in its prey, causing them to let down their guard. A moment later, it pounces.

species.name: Hawlucha
species.dexText: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. Its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

species.name: Dedenne
species.dexText: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

species.name: Carbink
species.dexText: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it defends itself by firing beams from the jewel part of its body.

species.name: Goomy
species.dexText: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it will need some thorough hand-washing.

species.name: Sliggoo
species.dexText: This Pokémon's mucous can dissolve anything. Toothless, it sprays mucous on its prey. Once they're nicely dissolved, it slurps them up.

species.name: Goodra
species.dexText: It gets picked on because it's meek. But then, whoever teased it gets to feel the full force of its horns and a good swatting from its thick tail.

species.name: Klefki
species.dexText: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them. It will sneak into people's homes to steal their keys.

species.name: Phantump
species.dexText: According to legend, medicine to cure any illness can be made by plucking the green leaves on its head, brewing them, and boiling down the liquid.

species.name: Trevenant
species.dexText: Through its roots, it exerts control over other trees. A deadly curse falls upon anyone cutting down trees in forests where Trevenant dwell.

species.name: Pumpkaboo
species.dexText: It is said to carry wandering spirits to the place where they belong so they can move on. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

species.name: Gourgeist
species.dexText: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song will become inflicted with a curse.

species.name: Avalugg
species.dexText: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back make it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

species.name: Noibat
species.dexText: They live in pitch-black caves. Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

species.name: Noivern
species.dexText: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles.

species.dexText: When its life comes to an end, its wings and tail spread wide and glow red, and it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon.

species.dexText: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. When its powers are sealed away, it is transformed into a much smaller form. It teleports things to a secret place.

species.name: Volcanion
species.dexText: It lets out billows of steam from the arms on its back and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

species.name: Rowlet
species.dexText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night. Silently it glides, drawing near to its target.

species.name: Dartrix
species.dexText: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

species.name: Decidueye
species.dexText: Decidueye is cool and cautious. It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances of over a hundred yards.

species.name: Litten
species.dexText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

species.name: Torracat
species.dexText: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire. With a single punch, it can bend an iron bar right over.

species.name: Incineroar
species.dexText: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

species.dexText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It practices diligently so it can learn to make big bubbles.

species.name: Brionne
species.dexText: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance with a sequence of water balloons to try and help.

species.name: Primarina
species.dexText: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

species.name: Primarina Mega
species.dexText: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

species.name: Pikipek
species.dexText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth. It uses holes in trees for nesting.

species.name: Trumbeak
species.dexText: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of calls and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors. It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak.

species.name: Toucannon
species.dexText: When it battles, within its beak, its internal gases ignite, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

species.name: Toucannon Mega
species.dexText: When it battles, within its beak, its internal gases ignite, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

species.name: Yungoos
species.dexText: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It wanders around in a never-ending search for food. At dusk, it collapses and falls asleep on the spot.

species.name: Gumshoos
species.dexText: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location... but as it's diurnal, it's always snoozing by nightfall.

species.name: Grubbin
species.dexText: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon, though it normally lives underground.

species.name: Charjabug
species.dexText: From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.

species.name: Vikavolt
species.dexText: It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its foes. It overwhelms bird Pokémon with shocking beams of electrical energy.

species.name: Crabrawler
species.dexText: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

species.name: Crabominable
species.dexText: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew thick fur.

species.dexText: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

species.name: Lycanroc
species.dexText: Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons. It will attack with no regard for its own safety.

species.dexText: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

species.name: Mareanie
species.dexText: It's found crawling on beaches and seafloors. The coral that grows on Corsola's head is as good as a five-star banquet to this Pokémon.

species.name: Toxapex
species.dexText: Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights. Post-recovery, there will be some aftereffects.

species.name: Mudbray
species.dexText: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait. Eating dirt, making mud, and playing in the mire form its daily routine.

species.name: Mudsdale
species.dexText: Its heavy, mud-covered kicks are its best means of attack, and it can reduce large trucks to scrap without breaking a sweat.

species.name: Dewpider
species.dexText: It crawls onto the land in search of food. When it comes across enemies or potential prey, this Pokémon smashes its water-bubble-covered head into them.

species.name: Araquanid
species.dexText: Despite what its appearance suggests, it cares for others. If it finds vulnerable, weak Pokémon, it protectively brings them into its water bubble.

species.name: Fomantis
species.dexText: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. They give off a sweet and refreshing scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall grass where Fomantis are hiding.

species.name: Lurantis
species.dexText: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis's vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.

species.name: Morelull
species.dexText: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

species.name: Shiinotic
species.dexText: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

species.name: Salandit
species.dexText: It burns its bodily fluids to create a sweet-smelling poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

species.name: Salazzle
species.dexText: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit to live with. Its poisonous gas is filled with pheromones.

species.name: Stufful
species.dexText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling. It's an incredibly dangerous Pokémon.

species.name: Bewear
species.dexText: This Pokémon has the habit of hugging its companions. Many Trainers have left this world after their spines were squashed by its hug.

species.name: Bounsweet
species.dexText: A delectable aroma pours from its body.  Bounsweet's sweat can be watered down into a juice with just the right amount of sweetness.

species.name: Steenee
species.dexText: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

species.name: Tsareena
species.dexText: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

species.dexText: It attaches flowers to its nutritious vine. Baths prepared with the flowers from its vine have a relaxing effect, so this Pokémon is a hit with many people.

species.name: Oranguru
species.dexText: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

species.name: Passimian
species.dexText: They battle with hard berries for weapons. They form groups of about 20 individuals. Their techniques are passed from the boss to the group, generation upon generation.

species.name: Wimpod
species.dexText: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake. It lives on beaches and seabeds.

species.name: Golisopod
species.dexText: It battles skillfully with its six arms, with a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater--or even air--right in two.

species.name: Sandygast
species.dexText: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth, to add to the accumulation of its sand-mound body. It embodies the grudges of the departed.

species.name: Palossand
species.dexText: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

species.name: Pyukumuku
species.dexText: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. The sticky mucous that covers their bodies can be used to soothe sunburned skin. How convenient!

species.name: Type: Null
species.dexText: Due to the danger that this synthetic Pokémon may go on a rampage, it wears a control mask to restrain its capabilities. It has some hidden special power.

species.dexText: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell encasing its body grows too heavy. It was born from mutated nanoparticles.

species.name: Minior Core Indigo
species.dexText: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell encasing its body grows too heavy. It was born from mutated nanoparticles.

species.name: Minior Core Violet
species.dexText: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell encasing its body grows too heavy. It was born from mutated nanoparticles.

species.name: Komala
species.dexText: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

species.name: Turtonator
species.dexText: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point. It gushes fire from its nostrils.

species.name: Togedemaru
species.dexText: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

species.name: Mimikyu
species.dexText: A lonely Pokémon, it hides its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokémon. Its actual appearance is unknown.

species.name: Mimikyu Busted
species.dexText: A lonely Pokémon, it hides its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokémon. Its actual appearance is unknown.

species.name: Mimikyu Apex
species.dexText: A lonely Pokémon, it hides its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokémon. Its actual appearance is unknown.

species.name: Mimikyu Primal
species.dexText: A lonely Pokémon, it hides its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokémon. Its actual appearance is unknown.

species.name: Mimikyu Apex Busted
species.dexText: A lonely Pokémon, it hides its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokémon. Its actual appearance is unknown.

species.name: Mimikyu Rayquaza Busted
species.dexText: A lonely Pokémon, it hides its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokémon. Its actual appearance is unknown.

species.name: Bruxish
species.dexText: It stuns its prey with its psychic powers and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

species.name: Bruxish Mega
species.dexText: It stuns its prey with its psychic powers and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

species.name: Drampa
species.dexText: This Pokémon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.

species.name: Dhelmise
species.dexText: The soul of seaweed adrift in the waves became reborn as this Pokémon. It maintains itself with new infusions of seabed detritus and seaweed.

species.name: Jangmo-o
species.dexText: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o live. They grow little by little battling one another.

species.name: Hakamo-o
species.dexText: It sheds and regrows its scales on a continuous basis. The scales become harder each time they're regrown. Its scaly punches tear its foes to shreds.

species.name: Kommo-o
species.dexText: Its rigid scales function as offense and defense. In the past, its scales were processed and used to make weapons and other valuable commodities.

species.name: Tapu Koko
species.dexText: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

species.name: Tapu Lele
species.dexText: A fragrant aroma of flowers follows it. As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health.

species.name: Tapu Bulu
species.dexText: It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth. It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around at its enemies.

species.name: Tapu Fini
species.dexText: People say it can create pure water that will wash away any corruption. The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies.

species.name: Cosmog
species.dexText: In ages past, it was called the child of the stars. It's said to be a Pokémon from another world, but no specific details are known.

species.name: Cosmoem
species.dexText: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell.

species.name: Solgaleo
species.dexText: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

species.name: Lunala
species.dexText: When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world. This Pokémon devours light, drawing the moonless dark veil of night over the brightness of day.

species.name: Nihilego
species.dexText: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. It's unclear whether or not this Pokémon is sentient, but sometimes it can be observed behaving like a young girl.

species.name: Buzzwole
species.dexText: This life-form called an Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

species.name: Pheromosa
species.dexText: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

species.name: Xurkitree
species.dexText: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.

species.name: Celesteela
species.dexText: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. One kind of Ultra Beast, witnesses saw it flying across the sky by expelling gas from its two arms.

species.name: Kartana
species.dexText: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.

species.name: Kartana Fallen
species.dexText: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.

species.name: Guzzlord
species.dexText: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. But for some reason its droppings have never been found.

species.name: Necrozma
species.dexText: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.

species.name: Dusk Mane
species.dexText: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.

species.name: Necrozma Ultra
species.dexText: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.

species.name: Dawn Wings
species.dexText: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.

species.name: Magearna
species.dexText: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.

species.name: Magearna Original
species.dexText: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.

species.name: Marshadow
species.dexText: Able to conceal itself in the shadows of others, it never appears before humans, so its very existence is the stuff of myth. This Pokémon is craven and cowering.

species.name: Poipole
species.dexText: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

species.name: Naganadel
species.dexText: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

species.name: Stakataka
species.dexText: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life- forms stacked one on top of each other.

species.name: Blacephalon
species.dexText: It slithers toward people and explode its head without warning. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

species.name: Zeraora
species.dexText: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

species.name: Meltan
species.dexText: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

species.name: Melmetal
species.dexText: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

species.name: Melmetal Mega
species.dexText: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

species.name: Grookey
species.dexText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

species.name: Thwackey
species.dexText: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

species.name: Rillaboom
species.dexText: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

species.name: Rillaboom Mega
species.dexText: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

species.name: Scorbunny
species.dexText: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

species.name: Raboot
species.dexText: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

species.name: Cinderace
species.dexText: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

species.name: Cinderace Mega
species.dexText: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

species.name: Sobble
species.dexText: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

species.name: Drizzile
species.dexText: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

species.name: Inteleon
species.dexText: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

species.name: Inteleon Mega
species.dexText: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

species.name: Skwovet
species.dexText: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

species.name: Greedent
species.dexText: It stashes berries in its tail--so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

species.name: Rookidee
species.dexText: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle--even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

species.name: Corvisquir
species.dexText: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

species.name: Corviknight
species.dexText: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

species.name: Corviknight Mega
species.dexText: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

species.name: Blipbug
species.dexText: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

species.name: Dottler
species.dexText: It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

species.name: Orbeetle
species.dexText: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

species.name: Orbeetle Mega
species.dexText: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

species.name: Nickit
species.dexText: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

species.name: Thievul
species.dexText: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

species.name: Gossifleur
species.dexText: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

species.name: Eldegoss
species.dexText: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.

species.name: Wooloo
species.dexText: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

species.name: Dubwool
species.dexText: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

species.name: Chewtle
species.dexText: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

species.name: Drednaw
species.dexText: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

species.name: Drednaw Mega
species.dexText: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

species.name: Yamper
species.dexText: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

species.name: Boltund
species.dexText: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

species.name: Rolycoly
species.dexText: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

species.name: Carkol
species.dexText: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

species.name: Coalossal
species.dexText: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Coalossal Mega
species.dexText: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Applin
species.dexText: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

species.name: Flapple
species.dexText: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

species.name: Appletun
species.dexText: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

species.name: Silicobra
species.dexText: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

species.name: Sandaconda
species.dexText: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

species.name: Sandaconda Mega
species.dexText: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

species.name: Cramorant
species.dexText: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

species.name: Cramorant Gulping
species.dexText: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

species.name: Cramorant Gorging
species.dexText: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

species.name: Arrokuda
species.dexText: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

species.name: Barraskewda
species.dexText: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

species.name: Toxel
species.dexText: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

species.name: Toxtricity
species.dexText: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

species.name: Toxtricity Mega
species.dexText: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

species.name: Toxtricity Low Key
species.dexText: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

species.name: Toxel Redux
species.dexText: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

species.name: Toxtricity Redux
species.dexText: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

species.name: Toxtricity Redux Mega
species.dexText: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

species.name: Toxtricity Redux Fuzz
species.dexText: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

species.name: Toxtricity Redux Fuzz Mega
species.dexText: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

species.name: Sizzlipede
species.dexText: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

species.name: Centiskorch
species.dexText: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

species.name: Centiskorch Mega
species.dexText: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

species.name: Clobbopus
species.dexText: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

species.name: Grapploct
species.dexText: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

species.name: Sinistea
species.dexText: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

species.name: Polteageist
species.dexText: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

species.name: Sinistea Antique
species.dexText: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

species.name: Polteageist Antique
species.dexText: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

species.name: Hatenna
species.dexText: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

species.name: Hattrem
species.dexText: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

species.name: Hatterene
species.dexText: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

species.name: Hatterene Mega
species.dexText: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

species.name: Impidimp
species.dexText: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

species.name: Morgrem
species.dexText: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

species.name: Grimmsnarl
species.dexText: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

species.name: Grimmsnarl Mega
species.dexText: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

species.name: Obstagoon
species.dexText: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout--this move is known as Obstruct.

species.name: Perrserker
species.dexText: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

species.name: Cursola
species.dexText: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

species.name: Sirfetch'd
species.dexText: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

species.name: Mr. Rime
species.dexText: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

species.name: Runerigus
species.dexText: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

species.name: Milcery
species.dexText: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

species.name: Alcremie
species.dexText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

species.name: Alcremie Mega
species.dexText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

species.dexText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

species.dexText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.
