species.dexText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

species.name: Alcremie Ruby Swirl
species.dexText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

species.name: Alcremie Caramel
species.dexText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

species.name: Alcremie Rainbow
species.dexText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

species.name: Falinks
species.dexText: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

species.name: Pincurchin
species.dexText: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

species.name: Snom
species.dexText: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

species.name: Frosmoth
species.dexText: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than -290 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Stonjourner
species.dexText: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

species.name: Eiscue
species.dexText: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

species.name: Eiscue Noice Face
species.dexText: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

species.name: Indeedee
species.dexText: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

species.name: Indeedee Female
species.dexText: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

species.name: Morpeko
species.dexText: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

species.name: Morpeko Hangry
species.dexText: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

species.name: Cufant
species.dexText: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

species.name: Copperajah
species.dexText: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

species.name: Copperajah Mega
species.dexText: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

species.name: Dracozolt
species.dexText: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

species.name: Arctozolt
species.dexText: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

species.name: Dracovish
species.dexText: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

species.name: Dracovish Mega
species.dexText: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

species.name: Arctovish
species.dexText: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

species.name: Duraludon
species.dexText: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

species.name: Duraludon Partner
species.dexText: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

species.name: Duraludon Mega
species.dexText: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

species.name: Dreepy
species.dexText: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

species.name: Drakloak
species.dexText: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

species.name: Dragapult
species.dexText: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

species.name: Zacian
species.dexText: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

species.name: Zacian Crowned
species.dexText: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

species.name: Zamazenta
species.dexText: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.

species.name: Zamazenta Crowned
species.dexText: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.

species.name: Eternatus
species.dexText: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

species.name: Eternatus Primal
species.dexText: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

species.name: Kubfu
species.dexText: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

species.name: Urshifu
species.dexText: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

species.name: Urshifu Mega
species.dexText: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

species.name: Urshifu Rapid Strike Style
species.dexText: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

species.name: Urshifu Rapid Strike Style Mega
species.dexText: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

species.name: Zarude
species.dexText: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

species.name: Zarude Dada
species.dexText: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

species.name: Regieleki
species.dexText: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It's said that removing the rings on Regieleki's body will unleash the Pokémon's latent power.

species.name: Regidrago
species.dexText: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago's arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.

species.name: Glastrier
species.dexText: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It's also a belligerent Pokémon-- anything it wants, it takes by force.

species.name: Spectrier
species.dexText: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one--it doesn't use its sense of sight. Spectrier's kicks are said to separate soul from body.

species.name: Spectrier Cloud
species.dexText: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one--it doesn't use its sense of sight. Spectrier's kicks are said to separate soul from body.

species.name: Calyrex
species.dexText: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

species.name: Calyrex Cloud Rider
species.dexText: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

species.name: Calyrex Ice Rider
species.dexText: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

species.name: Calyrex Shadow Rider
species.dexText: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

species.name: Wyrdeer
species.dexText: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers.

species.name: Kleavor
species.dexText: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields it self with hard stone. Should you chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, run.

species.name: Sneasler
species.dexText: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands.

species.name: Overqwil
species.dexText: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ''sea fiend''.  It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

species.name: Enamorus
species.dexText: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end.

species.name: Enamorus Therian
species.dexText: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end.

species.name: Sprigatito
species.dexText: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

species.name: Floragato
species.dexText: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

species.name: Meowscarada
species.dexText: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

species.name: Meowscarada Mega
species.dexText: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

species.name: Fuecoco
species.dexText: Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Crocalor
species.dexText: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

species.name: Skeledirge
species.dexText: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

species.name: Skeledirge Mega
species.dexText: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

species.name: Quaxly
species.dexText: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

species.name: Quaxwell
species.dexText: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

species.name: Quaquaval
species.dexText: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

species.name: Quaquaval Mega
species.dexText: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

species.name: Lechonk
species.dexText: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

species.name: Oinkologne
species.dexText: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

species.name: Tarountula
species.dexText: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

species.name: Spidops
species.dexText: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

species.name: Nymble
species.dexText: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

species.name: Lokix
species.dexText: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

species.name: Pawmi
species.dexText: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

species.name: Pawmo
species.dexText: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

species.name: Pawmot
species.dexText: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

species.name: Tandemaus
species.dexText: use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

species.name: Maushold
species.dexText: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

species.name: Maushold Four
species.dexText: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

species.name: Fidough
species.dexText: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

species.name: Fidough Partner
species.dexText: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

species.name: Fidough Mega
species.dexText: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

species.name: Dachsbun
species.dexText: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

species.name: Smoliv
species.dexText: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

species.name: Dolliv
species.dexText: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh- scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

species.name: Arboliva
species.dexText: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

species.name: Squawkabilly
species.dexText: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they're out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

species.name: Squawkabilly White
species.dexText: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they're out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

species.name: Squawkabilly Yellow
species.dexText: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they're out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

species.name: Squawkabilly Blue
species.dexText: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they're out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

species.name: Squawkabilly Green Plumage
species.dexText: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they're out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

species.name: Nacli
species.dexText: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli's body.

species.name: Naclstack
species.dexText: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

species.name: Garganacl
species.dexText: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

species.name: Charcadet
species.dexText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

species.name: Armarouge
species.dexText: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

species.name: Ceruledge
species.dexText: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

species.name: Tadbulb
species.dexText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

species.name: Bellibolt
species.dexText: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly- button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

species.name: Wattrel
species.dexText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

species.name: Kilowattrel
species.dexText: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There's hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

species.name: Maschiff
species.dexText: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

species.name: Mabosstiff
species.dexText: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

species.name: Shroodle
species.dexText: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

species.name: Grafaiai
species.dexText: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

species.name: Bramblin
species.dexText: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

species.name: Brambleghast
species.dexText: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

species.name: Toedscool
species.dexText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

species.name: Toedscruel
species.dexText: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

species.name: Klawf
species.dexText: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

species.name: Capsakid
species.dexText: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

species.name: Scovillain
species.dexText: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

species.name: Rellor
species.dexText: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

species.name: Rabsca
species.dexText: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

species.name: Flittle
species.dexText: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

species.name: Espathra
species.dexText: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

species.name: Tinkatink
species.dexText: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.

species.name: Tinkatuff
species.dexText: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other's hammers by smashing them together.

species.name: Tinkaton
species.dexText: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

species.name: Tinkaton Mega
species.dexText: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

species.name: Wiglett
species.dexText: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

species.name: Wugtrio
species.dexText: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

species.name: Bombirdier
species.dexText: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

species.name: Finizen
species.dexText: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

species.name: Palafin
species.dexText: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

species.name: Palafin Hero
species.dexText: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

species.name: Varoom
species.dexText: The steel section is Varoom's actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

species.name: Revavroom
species.dexText: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders- now numbering eight-to generate energy.

species.name: Cyclizar
species.dexText: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider's body heat warms Cyclizar's back and lifts the Pokémon's spirit.

species.name: Orthworm
species.dexText: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

species.name: Glimmet
species.dexText: Glimmet's toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

species.name: Glimmora
species.dexText: Glimmora's petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

species.name: Greavard
species.dexText: Glimmora's petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

species.name: Houndstone
species.dexText: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

species.name: Flamigo
species.dexText: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

species.name: Cetoddle
species.dexText: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

species.name: Cetitan
species.dexText: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

species.name: Veluza
species.dexText: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

species.name: Dondozo
species.dexText: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

species.name: Tatsugiri
species.dexText: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

species.name: Tatsugiri Curly
species.dexText: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

species.name: Tatsugiri Droopy
species.dexText: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

species.name: Tatsugiri Stretchy
species.dexText: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

species.name: Annihilape
species.dexText: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.

species.name: Clodsire
species.dexText: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It's a risky move that puts everything on the line.

species.name: Farigiraf
species.dexText: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

species.name: Great Tusk
species.dexText: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.

species.name: Scream Tail
species.dexText: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

species.name: Brute Bonnet
species.dexText: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

species.name: Flutter Mane
species.dexText: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

species.name: Slither Wing
species.dexText: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.

species.name: Sandy Shocks
species.dexText: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

species.name: Iron Treads
species.dexText: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

species.name: Iron Bundle
species.dexText: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.

species.name: Iron Hands
species.dexText: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.

species.name: Iron Jugulis
species.dexText: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

species.name: Iron Moth
species.dexText: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon's traits match up with an object described in an old book.

species.name: Iron Thorns
species.dexText: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.

species.name: Frigibax
species.dexText: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

species.name: Arctibax
species.dexText: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

species.name: Baxcalibur
species.dexText: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

species.name: Gimmighoul
species.dexText: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it's actually a Pokémon.

species.name: Gimmighoul Roaming
species.dexText: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it's actually a Pokémon.

species.name: Gholdengo
species.dexText: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

species.name: Wo Chien
species.dexText: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king's evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

species.name: Chien Pao
species.dexText: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.

species.name: Chien Pao Mega
species.dexText: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.

species.name: Ting Lu
species.dexText: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

species.name: Chi Yu
species.dexText: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

species.name: Roaring Moon
species.dexText: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to Mega Evolution that occurs in Hoenn.

species.name: Iron Valiant
species.dexText: It has some similarities to a mad scientist's invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

species.name: Koraidon
species.dexText: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

species.name: Miraidon
species.dexText: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an Violet Book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

species.name: Walking Wake
species.dexText: Ecology under research.

species.name: Iron Leaves
species.dexText: Ecology under analysis.

species.name: Dipplin
species.dexText: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.

species.name: Poltchageist
species.dexText: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.

species.name: Sinistcha
species.dexText: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

species.name: Okidogi
species.dexText: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.

species.name: Munkidori
species.dexText: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.

species.name: Fezandipiti
species.dexText: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.

species.name: Ogerpon
species.dexText: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

species.name: Ogerpon Hearthflame
species.dexText: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

species.name: Ogerpon Cornerstone
species.dexText: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

species.name: Ogerpon Wellspring
species.dexText: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

species.name: Archaludon
species.dexText: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It's so durable that being caught in a cave-in won't faze it.

species.name: Hydrapple
species.dexText: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.

species.name: Gouging Fire
species.dexText: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.

species.name: Raging Bolt
species.dexText: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.

species.name: Iron Boulder
species.dexText: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

species.name: Iron Crown
species.dexText: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

species.name: Terapagos
species.dexText: Upon sensing danger, it prepares itself for battle by creating a sturdy shell of crystallized Terastal energy.

species.name: Terapagos Primal
species.dexText: Upon sensing danger, it prepares itself for battle by creating a sturdy shell of crystallized Terastal energy.

species.name: Pecharunt
species.dexText: it's peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes  poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.

species.name: Phantowl
species.dexText: They fly through the night in total silence, searching for prey. They can faintly see the energy of living creatures, so the darker it is the harder it is to hide.

species.name: Duelumber
species.dexText: This is not a actually Pokémon. It's really just a potato Dont ask me why potato. Maybe because I like potatos.

species.name: Arachtres
species.dexText: It can use its 4 accessory legs walk upside-down and rotate its head 180 degrees. Beholding its uncanny movements incites fear to its now webbed victims.

species.name: Flairgrance
species.dexText: It unleashes waves of phermones to daze its targets. Its scents are powerful enough that some are used in making repels.

species.name: Arashinne
species.dexText: They are very clever and love to be taught new tricks. In the past, specially trained Arashinne were often used to send messages over great distances.

species.name: Dreadnaut
species.dexText: Despite its daunting appearance, it coexists peacefully with other Pokémon. It has never been witnessed feeding.

species.name: Boarlock
species.dexText: Its enemies can see visions of their demise reflected in its giant black pearl. Those that gaze at their reflection are lost in a trance and are easily compelled.

species.name: Heliomodo
species.dexText: Its paracolic frill allows it to harness and focus solar energy, which can be fired in the direction of its breath. It often scorches itself in the process.

species.name: Beefender
species.dexText: An unbelievably aggressive Pokémon, they evolve from male Combee in response to a serious threat against their Vespiquen.

species.name: Salazarus
species.dexText: It could evolve because it was unaffected by Salazzle's phermones. It attracts female Salandit, but it pines for the Salazzle that rejected it.

species.name: Gooschase
species.dexText: It keeps a watchful eye of its prey and only moves when unobserved by them. Only when it's too late will it be seen in motion.

species.name: Lepastry
species.dexText: It is desired by chefs all over due to its hammer producing the sweetest extract in the known world. The sweetness is so overwhelming it causes hysteria.

species.name: Brontonana
species.dexText: This long-lived Pokémon stores accumulated energy in its fruit. Unleashing all of its stored power at once will cause it to wilt and wither.

species.name: Dredwood
species.dexText: This pokemon is the soul of the forest and its greatest protector. It will bring ruin to all who attempt to destroy its home.

species.name: Corm
species.dexText: They release sweet syrup if fed a diet of sweet crops and fruits. Humans have domesticated Corm from its wild species thousands of years ago.

species.name: Iron Carapace
species.dexText: Studies show that this Pokémon's internal core is almost as hot as Magcargo. It is found around scrapyards eating cast off metals to power its body.

species.name: Kaiosea
species.dexText: It claims ocean currents as its domain and uses them to propel itself out of the water for true flight.

species.name: Marbeep
species.dexText: It is timid and stings lightly to avoid hurting itself. Most of those stung do not receive any venom.

species.name: Fluffbee
species.dexText: To repel parasites, they collect harsh pollen in their fleece. They often brush against each other to share their pollen.

species.name: Amphybuzz
species.dexText: They scent their honeycombs using the pollen of many flowers. They recognize each other at a distance by their aromas.

species.name: Amphybuzz Mega
species.dexText: They scent their honeycombs using the pollen of many flowers. They recognize each other at a distance by their aromas.

species.name: Phanfernal
species.dexText: Its pumpkin body can emit intense flames comparable to even a Heatran. The longer its flames burn, the more agile it becomes.

species.name: Skulberus
species.dexText: The alpha of its pack, Skulberus are rarely seen with trainers as they will only acknowledge the truly strong.

species.name: Velozel
species.dexText: They never stop moving, chasing the sun across the sky at supersonic speeds. You'll know one has passed by when your meal disappears with a sonic boom.

species.name: Bubbleo
species.dexText: Despite blending in perfectly in dark waters, these Pokémon prefer to hunt by chasing after their prey.

species.name: Hydroar
species.dexText: Able to travel faster than a Barraskewda in short bursts, these Pokémon now have the patience to lie in wait for prey to appear.

species.name: Hydroar F
species.dexText: Able to travel faster than a Barraskewda in short bursts, these Pokémon now have the patience to lie in wait for prey to appear.

species.name: Knaiver
species.dexText: An elusive Pokémon, it adapts to almost any surroundings, scavenging until it reaches its incredible potential.

species.name: Scizor
species.dexText: A Scizor has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. It flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.

species.name: Scizor Mega
species.dexText: A Scizor has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. It flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.

species.name: Sagaracas
species.dexText: They thrive in the deep desert, gathering water from the morning mists. Their powerful arms rattle as they move, warning others to stay away.

species.name: Lucineon
species.dexText: It appears that this species evolves from Lumineon who reside in proximity to the waters in the Cave of Origin.

species.name: Iron Voca
species.dexText: A peculiar robot Pokémon said to resemble Wigglytuff mixed with a pop star. It is capable of singing in any voice it desires.

species.name: Frostula
species.dexText: They construct breathtaking lairs of ice polished to a mirror sheen. Those who wander inside to admire the beauty are rarely seen again.

species.name: Weavile Mega
species.dexText: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

species.name: Samurott Mega
species.dexText: One swing of the seamitars attached to its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them is enough to intimidate most enemies.

species.name: Arcanine Mega
species.dexText: This fleet-footed Pokémon is said to run over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within its body is its source of power.

species.name: Goodra Mega
species.dexText: It gets picked on because it's meek. But then, whoever teased it gets to feel the full force of its horns and a good swatting from its thick tail.

species.name: Slowbro Mega Galarian
species.dexText: Its tail has a Shellder firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can't be used for fishing anymore. This forces it to reluctantly swim and catch prey.

species.name: Slowking Mega Galarian
species.dexText: It undertakes research every day to solve the mysteries of the world. However, it apparently forgets everything if the Shellder on its head comes off.

species.name: Iron Exo
species.dexText: An unknown virus Ultra Beast from Ultra Megalopolis that has taken refuge in the husk of a deceased Scizor. It closes resembles a future paradox pokemon.

species.name: Dududunsparce
species.dexText: They live in underground and only a few sightings have ever been recorded. Legends say that one got so large that it could circle around the entire world.
